baseline_models.mechanism: The settlements are not mere coordinates: the construction with مِن makes built habitation the material source from which a past people's consequence becomes presently legible.

activation_trace.role: The proper-name sense fixes ʿĀd as a concrete named collective, giving the visible sites an owner rather than leaving an abstract lesson.
Emergence into clarity turns what remains in the sites into disclosed evidence.
Residence in a home supplies the material location from which that disclosure is drawn.

changed_reading.before: The clause merely identifies where the two peoples lived.
changed_reading.after: Their former places of residence operate as a surviving forensic record that can be read by the present audience.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: زَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ
baseline_models.mechanism: Beautification alters the appraisal of intended conduct and thereby produces directional refusal. Perceptive capacity remains present, so the failure is not simple blindness but sight subordinated to an attractive valuation.

activation_trace.role: Making beauty appear supplies the valuation change that renders the agents' conduct attractive.
The rebellious instigator supplies an external promoter of the distorted valuation.
Purposeful action identifies the beautified object as conduct the agents themselves perform.
Turning or preventing supplies the causal displacement produced by that appraisal.
A traversable route supplies the orientation from which the actors are displaced.
Penetrating inner recognition keeps cognitive capacity present and makes the diversion culpably paradoxical.

changed_reading.before: They went astray because Satan concealed the truth from them.
changed_reading.after: They could discern, yet attractive interpretation of their own acts converted available sight into misdirected action.

baseline_models.mechanism: The verse spatializes temptation as distance and bent direction: adornment is not followed by an unrelated obstruction but is the lure by which separation from the route is made desirable.

activation_trace.role: The range of distance and severance gives the tempter a spatial signature that anticipates separation from the route.
Bent opposition contributes lateral deflection, making the mechanism a change of heading rather than loss of information.
Displayed attractiveness supplies the lure that makes the deflected heading appear preferable.
Active diversion converts the attractive heading into actual removal from the intended course.
The extended road supplies the spatial baseline against which the detour is measured.

changed_reading.before: Satan first made their acts attractive and then separately stopped them.
changed_reading.after: The attractive appearance is itself the detour mechanism that progressively produces distance from the way.

baseline_models.mechanism: The residence word can retain an undertone of motion coming to rest. Paired with the past-state construction, the inhabited life of perceptive agents is heard as an arrested condition preserved in its locations.

activation_trace.role: Cessation after movement lets the dwelling carry an undertone of arrested activity, not only an address.
Actual settlement keeps that stillness attached to their inhabited places.
Past occurrence fixes their perceptive condition as something once present but no longer governing the scene.
Their former inward discernment heightens the contrast between living cognition and the now-stilled habitation.

changed_reading.before: Their dwellings are neutral remains associated with a past people.
changed_reading.after: The dwellings can be heard as monuments in which once-perceptive movement and social life have come to a stop.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence portrays commitment as assayed, shows a sufferer actively reclassifying human pressure as equivalent to divine punishment, and later assigns humans the fabrication of falsehood. Satan therefore catalyzes and stabilizes a misvaluation of products the agents themselves author.

activation_trace.role: Assaying metal or person contributes discriminating pressure, so professed insight must demonstrate its quality.
Truth fulfilled in action contributes behavioral verification rather than mere correctness of speech.
Actively putting one thing into a stated condition supplies the sufferer's own construction of a false equivalence.
An ordeal bearing down on a person supplies the immediate pressure whose importance is misranked.
Fabricated discourse contributes human authorship of false material later available for beautification.
Making conduct display well supplies the reinforcing valuation imposed upon that humanly produced material.
Intentional deeds keep the actors causally involved in what is adorned.

structural_cues: The opening contrast is between saying belief and having that claim exposed under pressure.
A later sufferer actively makes social persecution comparable to divine punishment.
Human fabrication precedes the focus's possessive phrase their deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies testing, active reclassification, human fabrication, and the focus's own-deeds construction. Reader arrow: tested misvaluation generates material that Satanic adornment reinforces. Live alternative: these may be separate examples of failure rather than one feedback process.

changed_reading.before: An external tempter overwhelms otherwise innocent knowers.
changed_reading.after: Agents misrank pressures and fabricate practices under test; Satanic adornment amplifies this co-authored valuation loop rather than erasing their agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: A rival way is socially marketed by a promise that responsibility can be outsourced. The promise is false, and the next verse makes burdens accumulate, so the attraction of the substitute route includes a counterfeit indemnity.

activation_trace.role: Trailing and obeying another supplies the recruitment mechanism by which a group draws others onto its course.
The explicitly claimed route makes the focus's way one option contested by social guides.
Bearing a moral load supplies the promised transfer of liability used to sweeten following.
Contradiction of truth marks the indemnity promise as part of the deception.
Weight opposed to lightness makes the liabilities additive rather than removable.
The focus's active diversion is thereby supplied with a concrete social sales mechanism.

structural_cues: The imperative to follow our way is immediately paired with a promise to carry the followers' errors.
The following line repeats carrying and adds other burdens alongside the leaders' own.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies rival guidance, promised burden transfer, its falsity, and accumulating loads. Reader arrow: false immunity is one attractive feature by which diversion recruits. Live alternative: the promise may exemplify lying leadership without defining the focus's adornment.

changed_reading.before: The way is a generic moral path from which individuals wander.
changed_reading.after: The way is contested by organized recruiters who beautify an alternative through the false promise that its consequences can be carried by someone else.

context_deltas.mechanism: Commands to traverse the earth and direct eye and mind toward beginnings, returns, and deliberately preserved signs turn the focus's dwellings into a field of causal inquiry. The audience is invited to inspect material residue and infer process, not merely receive a reported moral.

activation_trace.role: The inhabited site remains the focus anchor and becomes the field object subjected to inspection.
Seeing with eye or insight supplies the observational act required to read visible processes.
The explicit coupling of inception with recurrence supplies a process model rather than an isolated spectacle.
Return after an initial act supplies the second movement whose traces can be inferred from the first.
Actual movement through the land converts reading signs into itinerant field observation.
Directed visual and reflective attention supplies the method by which the landscape becomes evidence.
Leaving something behind contributes an intentionally surviving residue available after its owners are gone.
A preserved object's disclosure into clarity directly primes the focus's becoming-clear construction.

structural_cues: Seeing creation's beginning and return is followed by the command to travel and inspect the earth.
A deliberately surviving clear sign occurs immediately before the focus's appeal to dwellings.
The repeated movement is from material observation to reflective inference.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies travel, directed looking, beginning-return comparison, and a deliberately left clear sign. Reader arrow: the same observational protocol governs the inference from the focus's dwellings. Live alternative: the focus may simply assume familiar ruins without prescribing a method.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings are a static monument confirming a known story.
changed_reading.after: They are field evidence through which a moving observer reconstructs causal history and learns how beginnings, conduct, and endings relate.

context_deltas.mechanism: Idolatrous practice is said to furnish affection and relational connection in present life, then that bond reverses into reciprocal repudiation and expulsion. Adornment can therefore operate through the genuine short-term social rewards of a shared practice, not only through private aesthetic illusion.

activation_trace.role: Displayed attractiveness supplies the focus anchor whose content is now specified as a social payoff.
Acquiring something for oneself contributes deliberate construction of the shared devotional arrangement.
A worshiped material object supplies the social center around which the arrangement coheres.
Affection contributes the immediate interpersonal reward that can make the practice attractive.
A connective relation between parties turns that affection into social structure rather than private feeling.
Mutual disavowal tears apart the bond and exposes its inability to carry into the later scene.
Expulsion under anger supplies the final reversal from attraction and proximity to hostile distance.

structural_cues: Affection between you is followed by repeated some of you against some of you constructions.
The temporal pivot reverses present social cohesion into later mutual repudiation and cursing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies shared objects, worldly affection, relational connection, and its reciprocal reversal. Reader arrow: social belonging is part of what beautifies the deeds and diverts participants. Live alternative: the focus's adornment may be individual even though this neighboring example is communal.

changed_reading.before: Satan makes an individual's bad act look personally pleasurable.
changed_reading.after: A practice may look good because it manufactures belonging; its social glue is real in the short term even though it later reverses into severance.

context_deltas.mechanism: A material sequence contrasts leaving one abode, bodies immobilized in their home, reliance on a structurally weak house, widened space for worship, and active installation in enduring rooms. The focus's settlements become nodes in a moral topology of attachment, movement, false shelter, and rehousing.

activation_trace.role: Loss of movement within the settlement word supplies the focus's arrested-habitation pole.
Actual residence keeps the model anchored in concrete inhabited space.
Departure from one abode toward another supplies chosen mobility as an alternative to attachment.
A body adhering to the ground and its place materializes the fatal endpoint of immobility at home.
A shelter used for lodging supplies the architectural image of trusted protection.
Loss of strength exposes that protective architecture as unable to bear reliance.
Spatial expansiveness breaks the claim that worship requires remaining trapped in one hostile dwelling.
Preparing and installing someone in a lodging supplies deliberate rehousing after faithful movement.
Durable continuance supplies the stability that the weak and ruined habitations lacked.

structural_cues: Migration is followed by a story ending with people fixed to the ground inside their home.
The weak house image is later answered by wide earth and promised installation in enduring dwellings.
Good works and corrupt attachment lead to contrasting architectures of residence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies migration, immobilization at home, weak shelter, spatial width, and durable rehousing. Reader arrow: these form a mobility-and-habitation mechanism around the focus's settlements. Live alternative: they may be independent contrasts rather than one continuous topology.

changed_reading.before: The settlements only preserve evidence after destruction.
changed_reading.after: Settlement itself becomes morally dynamic: false refuge immobilizes, faithful departure opens space, and rightly directed action receives a more durable habitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: A community that cuts the road and normalizes rejected conduct in its assembly externalizes the focus's diversion. Those first turned from the way can become physical and institutional obstacles to other travelers.

activation_trace.role: Active prevention supplies the focus's initial state of being displaced from the route.
The traveled road supplies the common passage whose accessibility is at stake.
Seizing and obstructing travelers makes route-cutting an outward social practice, not merely an inward deviation.
The repeated road lexeme directly identifies the same spatial object as something a community can interrupt.
A public gathering place supplies the institution in which the behavior is collectively performed and normalized.
A deed rejected by sound judgment supplies the normative content made public in that assembly.
Departure from sound order supplies the system-level result of private deviation becoming public infrastructure.

structural_cues: Route-cutting and assembly-based wrongdoing occur in one coordinated accusation.
The response names the community by its production of corruption rather than by isolated private acts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies literal route obstruction, public assembly, rejected conduct, and communal corruption. Reader arrow: diverted actors propagate diversion by becoming blockers of others. Live alternative: cutting the road may remain one offense among several rather than a model of transmission.

changed_reading.before: The focus portrays a group only as victims of Satanic redirection.
changed_reading.after: Misdirection can reproduce itself socially: the redirected community occupies public space and obstructs the route for subsequent travelers.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clear proofs can be publicly displayed, located within chests, and correctly acknowledged in speech, yet pride, knowing denial, and directional inversion prevent them from orienting conduct. The focus's discernment is thus an indictment of unused cognition rather than a commendation.

activation_trace.role: Inner discernment supplies cognitive availability while leaving practical orientation unresolved.
Proofs disclosed into visibility show that the neighboring resisters likewise lack no evidentiary access.
Self-exaltation and refusal supply a motivational gate that blocks evidence from governing action.
The bodily chest supplies an interior location for clear signs, intensifying the contrast with outward ruins.
Denial of what is inwardly affirmed supplies a deliberate break between recognition and confession.
An articulated correct answer supplies propositional acknowledgment without corresponding direction.
Being turned from a proper face supplies the directional inversion that follows correct speech.
Intelligence that should restrain error supplies the missing operation between acknowledgment and faithful action.

structural_cues: Clear proofs are followed immediately by arrogant refusal.
Clear signs are placed inside knowledgeable chests while knowing denial remains possible.
Speakers correctly name the creator and giver of rain, yet are described as turned and failing to reason.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies external, internal, and verbal forms of recognition together with pride, knowing denial, and inversion. Reader arrow: these recurring layers explain how the focus's discerning people remain off-course. Live alternative: the groups differ, so the recurrence may be thematic analogy rather than one psychology.

changed_reading.before: The final concessive is a puzzling statement that intelligent people somehow erred.
changed_reading.after: It precisely distinguishes possession of evidence from submission to its direction: sight, inward knowledge, and correct speech can all remain operationally sterile.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's visually beautified deeds later become the basis on which each person is seized, an already surrounding environment, and something experientially tasted. Conduct returns upon its maker, reversing attractive appearance into embodied consequence.

activation_trace.role: Displayed beauty supplies the initial sensory appraisal under which the deeds are chosen.
Purposeful conduct identifies what will later be returned to experience.
Being taken to account for what issued from oneself supplies the first return of consequence upon the agent.
Culpable action supplies the specific attachment between each seizure and its bearer.
The person's own self supplies the reflexive locus upon which the misdirected conduct falls.
Unexpected arrival supplies the temporal reversal from apparently successful conduct to sudden consequence.
Fine awareness supplies the perception absent at the moment when the delayed result arrives.
Overwhelming enclosure turns consequence into an environment already surrounding those who request it.
Experiential tasting converts a previously visual judgment of beauty into personally undergone knowledge.
The repeated deed vocabulary identifies the tasted experience with the actors' own prior conduct.

structural_cues: Immediately after the focus, each community is taken in connection with its own culpable act.
Later punishment is first unexpected, then described as already enclosing.
The command to taste is grammatically tied to what they used to do.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies beautified deeds, seizure for one's act, enclosure, and tasting what was done. Reader arrow: conduct feeds back as an experienced environment upon its maker. Live alternative: the tasting formula may express ordinary recompense without implying material transformation of deeds.

changed_reading.before: The deeds are deceptive objects of judgment that receive a separate punishment later.
changed_reading.after: The deeds form a feedback process: what looked beautiful returns upon the self as an enclosing and tasted consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's obstruction from the way is answered by a ritual practice that itself restrains obscenity and rejected conduct. Competing formative systems are at work: beautified practice channels away from the route, while prayer and remembrance install an opposing inhibition.

activation_trace.role: The focus's preventing force supplies one side of the opposed inhibitory structure.
The route supplies the positive orientation that the first inhibition blocks.
The embodied worship with prescribed movements supplies the counter-formative practice.
Restraint and deterrence supply prayer's active blocking function against the rival course.
Manifest grave ugliness supplies one class of conduct that the counterpractice interrupts.
Conduct rejected by sound judgment supplies the second target of ritual restraint.
Keeping something present after forgetfulness supplies remembrance as sustained cognitive orientation.
What people actively produce keeps divine knowledge directed toward enacted practice, not merely belief.

structural_cues: The focus says an agent blocks people from the way; the later ritual is said to block people from two classes of conduct.
Remembrance and divine knowledge of what is made frame the ritual's practical effect.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies two opposed acts of restraint, an embodied ritual, remembrance, and ongoing human production. Reader arrow: repeated practice forms a counter-habit capable of resisting beautified conduct. Live alternative: the ritual line may state a normative effect without specifying a psychological habit mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Correct perception should by itself defeat Satanic deception.
changed_reading.after: Perception needs a practiced counter-inhibition: prayer and remembrance can redirect conduct by blocking the acts that an attractive rival system normalizes.

context_deltas.mechanism: Danger at sea strips away competing attachments and produces exclusive devotion; rescue onto stable land is followed by renewed association. A safe sanctuary is visibly surrounded by human vulnerability, yet falsehood is still embraced. Discernment can therefore be episodic and security-dependent rather than a stable governing trait.

activation_trace.role: What the self settles into for reassurance supplies the focus anchor for familiar security.
Exclusive separation from partners supplies the clarity that danger temporarily elicits.
Release from peril supplies the environmental transition after which the prior clarity reverses.
Dry land supplies regained stability and the setting in which association reappears.
Reintroducing partners supplies the relapse that follows restored safety.
Available sight makes the surrounding contrast between sanctuary and vulnerability consciously accessible.
A settled condition free from fear supplies the attractive security that can be misattributed.
Rapid seizure of people nearby supplies the visible danger outside the protected enclave.
What lacks truth and stability supplies the false object embraced despite visible protection.

structural_cues: Exclusive devotion during maritime danger reverses immediately after safe landing.
The protected enclave is contrasted with people being seized around it, followed by belief in falsehood.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies crisis devotion, rescue, landward relapse, visible sanctuary, and surrounding danger. Reader arrow: familiar safety permits old social valuations to reassert themselves. Live alternative: the sequence may diagnose ingratitude without making discernment psychologically state-dependent.

changed_reading.before: They possessed a stable faculty of insight but inexplicably ignored it.
changed_reading.after: Their clarity may have been real but episodic: danger activates undivided perception, while restored security lets familiar adorned attachments regain control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing promise reverses the focus's pattern: bare discernment coexists with being blocked from a singular way, whereas strenuous committed action is followed by divine guidance into multiple paths. Orientation emerges through enacted fidelity, not cognition alone.

activation_trace.role: Possessed inward recognition supplies the insufficient cognitive state at the focus's blocked pole.
Diversion supplies the closure that insight alone does not overcome.
The singular traveled route supplies the path from which the earlier people are excluded.
Expenditure of capacity under difficulty supplies committed movement beyond passive knowing.
Gentle direction toward truth supplies the divine answer to the earlier obstruction.
Plural traversable routes supply an opened field of faithful movement rather than continued blockage.
Beautifully enacted beneficence supplies the ethical quality of the travelers whose paths are opened.

structural_cues: The focus joins discernment to blocked movement, while the ending joins strenuous action to promised guidance.
The singular way in the focus is answered by plural paths at the close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies insight without movement and an explicit effort-to-guidance sequence with plural paths. Reader arrow: the ending functions as the focus's practical countermechanism. Live alternative: the plural may denote several modes within one way rather than an emphasis on newly opened access.

changed_reading.before: The problem is solved by seeing the one road more clearly.
changed_reading.after: Seeing is insufficient without committed movement; striving elicits guidance and unfolds several traversable expressions of the one faithful orientation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because عَادًا is first a proper name and should not be translated as return or habit. It remains anchored because its supplied inventory also contains recurrence, ingrained custom, and an old traveled road, while the context explicitly activates return and later depicts relapse after rescue. Render only as a consonantal or root-image resonance, never as the lexical meaning or an historical claim about the tribe's name.

activation_trace.role: The primary proper-name use keeps the named people fixed as the literal referent.
Conduct hardened through repetition supplies an exploratory echo of the deeds becoming customary.
An old, repeatedly traveled road links the name's peripheral range to the focus's route imagery.
Actual recurrence after an initial act supplies the context-backed trigger for hearing return as a secondary resonance.
Renewed association after deliverance supplies a narrative instance of relapse into an old pattern.
The focus's traveled way gives the habitual-return image a concrete directional anchor.

changed_reading.before: ʿĀd is simply the first proper name in a catalogue of destroyed peoples.
changed_reading.after: As a contained sound-root resonance, the name can faintly evoke habitual return along an old road, making the named ruin warn about recurrent patterns rather than only a remote people.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the focus surface أَعْمَال means deeds, whereas the peripheral image concerns a road worn by use. It remains worth carrying because deeds, blocking, prayer's restraint, striving, and paths repeatedly form one action-direction chain. Downstream prose should present it as a material analogy: repeated acts wear a track; it must not replace the ordinary sense of deeds.

activation_trace.role: Intentional conduct supplies the repeated human motion from which a behavioral track can arise.
A road made passable by repeated use materializes deeds as the track their repetition wears.
The traveled route supplies the directional structure that accumulated conduct can reinforce or displace.
Practical restraint supplies an interruption capable of preventing the rival track from being worn further.
Ongoing production by human agents keeps path formation attached to what they repeatedly make and do.
Sustained exertion supplies the repeated movement through which a counterpath becomes traversable.
The opened paths supply the positive counterpart to the track worn by adorned conduct.

changed_reading.before: Satan beautifies acts and then independently blocks a preexisting road.
changed_reading.after: Repeated beautified acts may be imagined as wearing the detour that thereafter channels conduct, while disciplined action wears and opens counterpaths.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus plainly uses السبيل as a road and الشيطان as the tempter, while the selected peripheral branches supply an ocular film and a long cord. It remains anchored through the explicit sight claim and the nearby image of a web-making creature's weak house. Render only as a woven material analogy for impaired navigation, not as a lexical substitution for way or Satan.

activation_trace.role: A long tightly made cord supplies the tethering strand in an exploratory image of entanglement.
A woven-looking film over the eye supplies a thin obstruction that impairs orientation without removing the eye.
Physical sight keeps the model centered on a faculty that remains present beneath the overlay.
Inner discernment extends the same image from optical vision to practical judgment.
The web-making creature supplies the contextual trigger for treating the obstruction as fine woven structure.
A structure mistaken for shelter supplies the web's deceptive protective appearance.
Failure of structural strength exposes the apparently protective web as an unreliable restraint.

changed_reading.before: The perceptive actors encounter a solid external blockade on the road.
changed_reading.after: Their paradox can be visualized as webbed sight: a fine attractive overlay and tether leave perception technically present while distorting navigation and simulating shelter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because the focus's ordinary الطريق sense does not mean rain, and its blocking verb does not literally describe a water system. It remains anchored because peripheral focus branches supply a route to water and descending rain, while the context explicitly gives water reviving dead earth. Qualify it as an ecological analogy for access to life, not as a translation.

activation_trace.role: A track leading to water materializes obstruction as denial of access to a sustaining source.
Rain extending between cloud and ground supplies a vertical conduit image for the way.
The inhabited settlement supplies the ecological recipient that flourishes or becomes residue according to access.
Delivery from above supplies the opening of the life-bearing conduit.
Actual water supplies the material source whose arrival changes the earth's condition.
Vegetative revival through rain supplies the causal result of restored access.
Loss of vitality supplies the prior condition reversed when the conduit reaches the land.

changed_reading.before: The way is an abstract moral road from which they are turned.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can also be imagined as a life-bearing channel: obstruction desiccates habitation, while an opened conduit revives what had become dead.

strongest_changes: Discernment became non-exculpatory: evidence may be external, internal, and verbally acknowledged while pride and valuation still prevent orientation.
Diversion became social and infrastructural: belonging can beautify a practice, and redirected communities can obstruct the route for others.
Settlements became a mobility architecture contrasting immobilized or weak refuge with migration, widened earth, and durable rehousing.
Beautified deeds became a feedback system that returns as personal, enclosing, and tasted consequence.
Prayer and committed striving supplied practical countermechanisms to Satanic obstruction rather than merely additional information.
summary.what_was_special: The focus tightly joins dwellings, disclosure, beauty, intentional work, obstruction, route, and retained sight. Context activated these as forensic, cognitive, social, architectural, ritual, sensory, and ecological mechanisms, while peripheral branches yielded contained images of deeds wearing roads, webbed vision, life-bearing channels, and habitual return.
remaining_uncertainties: مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ may denote genuine discernment, deliberate scrutiny, or confidence in being astute; the mechanism changes emphasis with that nuance.
The unexpressed subject of تَبَيَّنَ leaves open whether the dwellings disclose destruction, culpability, or both.
The long mobility-and-rehousing sequence may be an integrated topology or several independent contrasts.
The proper-name, woven-eye, worn-road, and hydrological activations are controlled analogies from peripheral branches, not secure lexical senses of the focus surfaces.
